full_window_estimates.conclusion: Persistent full-window tape artifacts do not fit on this VM (89.9GB > 68GB free). A3 must stream day-by-day (build, replay, discard) or use larger disks; raw zips (10.6GB) plus the deterministic builder keep every tape reproducible.

a3_blockers: Disk: 546 persistent fold tapes project to ~90GB vs 68GB free. Streaming per-day execution is the viable design; it is not yet implemented in qel/research/m2.py (which is dev-week only).

Controls memory: ControlPlan materialises every quote (456 train+val days x 86,400 quotes/day = ~39M quote objects) far beyond 11Gi RAM. Full-fold control fitting needs a streaming redesign that preserves the frozen selection protocol.

Compute: full-fold 12-variant replays (6,552 day-variants) plus 1,000 control seeds at fold scale are unmeasured; per-day replay is ~28s/variant-day at HEAD binary, i.e. ~51 CPU-hours for variants alone single-threaded before controls.
a1_gate: ELIGIBLE at 100/1000 USDT budgets (BTC 20 USDT remains INFEASIBLE_VENUE_MIN_NOTIONAL); m2-run default capital 1000 x risk 0.1 = 100 USDT notional passes the feasibility gate.
